coverage.label_scope: core targets, supplied plan, observed mount targets and discovered sandbox JSONs

cfg_layer_probe.cmd:
for root in /system /chipset /sys_prod /chip_prod; do printf "LAYER %s
" "$root"; ls -ldZ "$root/lib64/seccomp"; printf "DIR_PROBE_RC %s
" "$?"; ls -ldZ "$root/lib64/seccomp/libapp_filter.z.so"; printf "FILE_PROBE_RC %s
" "$?"; done

init_cfgs.cmd: set -eu; for root in /system/etc/init /vendor/etc/init /chipset/etc/init; do if ! test -d "$root"; then printf "ROOT_UNAVAILABLE %s\n" "$root"; continue; fi; files=$(find "$root" -type f -name "*.cfg"); if [ -n "$files" ]; then printf "%s\n" "$files" | while IFS= read -r entry; do sha256sum "$entry"; done; fi; done

labels_005.cmd: set -eu; test -d /system/android; entries=$(find /system/android -print) || exit; printf "%s\n" "$entries" | while IFS= read -r entry; do ls -Zd "$entry" || exit; done

labels_049.cmd: set -eu; test -d /system/etc/sandbox; entries=$(find /system/etc/sandbox -print) || exit; printf "%s\n" "$entries" | while IFS= read -r entry; do ls -Zd "$entry" || exit; done

pids_appspawn.cmd: found=$(pidof appspawn); code=$?; if [ "$code" = 1 ] && [ -z "$found" ]; then printf "NO_PROCESS\n"; elif [ "$code" != 0 ]; then exit "$code"; else printf "%s\n" "$found"; fi

pids_appspawn-x.cmd: found=$(pidof appspawn-x); code=$?; if [ "$code" = 1 ] && [ -z "$found" ]; then printf "NO_PROCESS\n"; elif [ "$code" != 0 ]; then exit "$code"; else printf "%s\n" "$found"; fi

pids_foundation.cmd: found=$(pidof foundation); code=$?; if [ "$code" = 1 ] && [ -z "$found" ]; then printf "NO_PROCESS\n"; elif [ "$code" != 0 ]; then exit "$code"; else printf "%s\n" "$found"; fi

proc_appspawn-x_4625_environ_keys.cmd: set -eu; envraw=$(cat /proc/4625/environ | tr "\000" "\n"); printf "%s\n" "$envraw" | cut -d= -f1 | sort -u

sandbox_json.cmd: set -eu; files=$(find /system/etc /system/android/etc -type f \( -iname "*sandbox*.json" -o -iname "appspawn*.json" \)); if [ -n "$files" ]; then printf "%s\n" "$files" | while IFS= read -r entry; do sha256sum "$entry"; done; fi

seccomp_sha.cmd: set -eu; files=$(find /system/lib64/seccomp -type f); printf "%s\n" "$files" | while IFS= read -r entry; do sha256sum "$entry"; done
